mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO notification_policy_step ( id, policy_version_id, step_order, delay_seconds, channel_id, recipient_group_id, template_id, recovery_template_id, ticket_action, ticket_priority ) VALUES
( #{step.id}, #{step.policyVersionId}, #{step.stepOrder}, #{step.delaySeconds}, #{step.channelId}, #{step.recipientGroupId}, #{step.templateId}, #{step.recoveryTemplateId}, #{step.ticketAction}, #{step.ticketPriority} )
mapper.select: SELECT policy.id AS policyId, policy.policy_code AS policyCode, version.match_conditions::text AS matchConditionsJson, version.severity_filter::text AS severityFilterJson FROM notification_policy policy JOIN notification_policy_version version ON version.policy_id = policy.id AND version.state = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE policy.status = 'ACTIVE' AND policy.priority = #{priority} AND policy.id <> #{excludedPolicyId} ORDER BY policy.policy_code, policy.id
